subject: Offer mix confirmation — Samuel Parker (SDE2, REQ-2028-214)
messages:
From: Evan Cho <evan.cho@brightsearch.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate offer: Samuel Parker (SDE2) — proposed mix

Hi Vanessa / Marissa —

Thanks again for taking a look. Quick summary for Samuel Parker (finalist for SDE2, REQ-2028-214):
- Location: SF (remote-flex)
- Base: $160,000
- Target bonus: 15% (annual)
- RSU grant: 40,000 units (~$110k estimated at grant) vesting 4y
- Start date target: 2028-09-10

Attached: candidate profile, comp band chart, req headcount doc. Recruiter note: candidate has competing offer at $170k base + 10% bonus and smaller RSU. Hiring manager Karthik is recommending the mix above to keep total comp competitive while staying inside the SDE2 band.

Requesting: formal sign-off from compensation / approvals to extend offer by EOD so we can lock the candidate. Please confirm any changes to base/equity mix you want before I draft the official offer.

Files: Samuel_Parker_Offer_Candidate_Profile.pdf (resume + references), comp_band_SDE2_Q3_2028.png, REQ-2028-214-headcount.pdf

Thanks,
Evan Cho
Senior Recruiter, BrightSearch
Phone: (415) 555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate offer: Samuel Parker (SDE2) — proposed mix

Vanessa — thanks for looping me in, Evan. Reviewed the attached band and the req. A few thoughts: 

1) The proposed base ($160k) puts the candidate at the high end of the midpoint for SDE2 for SF. That’s fine if the RSU take-home is adjusted, but the total on-target comp (base + cash bonus + grant) is trending toward the low L4 range.
2) To keep offer alignment with our standard SDE2 band and preserve internal equity, we should prefer shifting more into RSUs rather than increasing base. Suggest either:
   - Option A (preferred): Base $155k, 18% bonus, RSU 48,000 (higher equity tilt)
   - Option B (manager-led exception): Keep base $160k, 15% bonus, RSU 40,000 but require manager sign-off to mark as "market exception" (will need People Ops approval).

Also need confirmation that the req budget code (CC-ENG-2028-07) has headcount clearance. I’m copying Lauren for headcount/finance confirmation. If we go Option B, I’ll need written approval from Karthik + final confirmation from Lauren so I can clear comp pool.

Marissa Cole
Director, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Evan Cho <evan.cho@brightsearch.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate offer: Samuel Parker (SDE2) — proposed mix

Marissa — thanks for the careful read. Short version: I recommend Option B (manager-led exception) and here's why:

- Team velocity risk: this candidate has specific infra experience (LLM inference runtime) we urgently need. Replacing will likely take 10+ weeks and we risk backlog on two critical tickets.
- Candidate leverage: confirmed competing $170k base offer — if we pull back base to $155k we likely lose them.
- Budget: there is capacity in the hiring bucket this quarter (CC-ENG-2028-07) to cover a one-off exception within hiring manager tolerance; I’ll absorb the incremental run-rate in my team's FY forecast.

I’m happy to sign the manager exception form and confirm communication to People Ops. If comp needs to be re-traded, I prefer keeping base at $160k and increasing RSUs to 44k rather than reducing base.

Karthik Iyer
Engineering Manager, Inference Runtime

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, Evan Cho <evan.cho@brightsearch.com>, Samuel Parker <samuel.parker@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate offer: Samuel Parker (SDE2) — proposed mix

Thanks all — after weighing comp parity and time-to-hire risk I approve Option B as a manager exception:
- Base: $160,000
- Target bonus: 15%
- RSU: 44,000 units (4y vesting)
- Finance code: CC-ENG-2028-07; Req: REQ-2028-214

Marissa, please mark this as a manager exception in the compensation approval tracker and attach the signed manager exception note (Karthik). Lauren, please confirm headcount is green for offer issuance and that payroll/benefits will process a 09/10 start. Evan — you may proceed to extend the verbal + written offer to Samuel with the above mix.

Attachments sent to candidate upon finalization: draft offer letter (PDF), equity grant overview (PDF), relocation/benefits package (if applicable).

Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference
